RER Misclassification Analysis¶

Analyze failure cases of RER-based classification from trained self-supervised autoencoders. Works for both feature-based (DINO/CLIP) and convolutional (raw images) setups.

Run Evaluation¶

In [8]:
# Collect all reconstruction errors, labels, and sample IDs
all_errors_list = []
all_labels_list = []
all_ids_list = []
all_features_list = []

with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in dataloader:
        features, labels, sample_ids = batch
        features = features.to(DEVICE)

        errors = model.ae_manager.compute_all_reconstruction_errors(features)
        all_errors_list.append(errors.cpu())
        all_labels_list.append(labels)
        all_ids_list.append(sample_ids)
        all_features_list.append(features.cpu())

all_errors = torch.cat(all_errors_list, dim=0)     # [N, K]
true_labels = torch.cat(all_labels_list, dim=0)     # [N]
sample_ids = torch.cat(all_ids_list, dim=0)          # [N]
all_features = torch.cat(all_features_list, dim=0)   # [N, D]
N = all_errors.shape[0]

# Predictions: class with minimum reconstruction error
predictions = all_errors.argmin(dim=1)

# 2nd best: mask the best class, then argmin again
errors_masked = all_errors.clone()
errors_masked[torch.arange(N), predictions] = float("inf")
second_best = errors_masked.argmin(dim=1)

# RER values (using true labels as reference)
rer_values = compute_rer(all_errors, true_labels)

# Confidence margin: error gap between best and 2nd best
best_errors = all_errors[torch.arange(N), predictions]
second_errors = all_errors[torch.arange(N), second_best]
margin = (second_errors - best_errors).abs()

# Own-class error and predicted-class error
own_class_errors = all_errors[torch.arange(N), true_labels.long()]
pred_class_errors = best_errors

# Build DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "sample_id": sample_ids.numpy(),
    "true_label": true_labels.numpy().astype(int),
    "predicted": predictions.numpy().astype(int),
    "second_best": second_best.numpy().astype(int),
    "rer": rer_values.numpy(),
    "own_class_error": own_class_errors.numpy(),
    "pred_class_error": pred_class_errors.numpy(),
    "margin": margin.numpy(),
    "correct": (predictions == true_labels).numpy(),
})

# Add class name columns
df["true_name"] = df["true_label"].map(lambda x: class_names[x] if x < len(class_names) else str(x))
df["pred_name"] = df["predicted"].map(lambda x: class_names[x] if x < len(class_names) else str(x))
df["second_name"] = df["second_best"].map(lambda x: class_names[x] if x < len(class_names) else str(x))

print(f"Evaluation complete: {N} samples")
print(f"Correct: {df['correct'].sum()} ({df['correct'].mean()*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"Misclassified: {(~df['correct']).sum()} ({(~df['correct']).mean()*100:.1f}%)")
df.head(10)

# Per-class chi and accuracy
class_chi = compute_class_chi(rer_values, true_labels)
per_class = []
for c in range(num_classes):
    mask = df["true_label"] == c
    n_total = mask.sum()
    n_correct = (df.loc[mask, "correct"]).sum()
    per_class.append({
        "class": c,
        "name": class_names[c],
        "chi": class_chi.get(c, 0.0),
        "accuracy": n_correct / max(n_total, 1),
        "n_samples": n_total,
        "n_errors": n_total - n_correct,
    })
df_class = pd.DataFrame(per_class).sort_values("chi", ascending=False)

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(max(10, num_classes * 0.25), 8))

# Per-class chi (bar chart, sorted by difficulty)

axes[0].set_xticklabels([class_names[c] for c in order], rotation=90, fontsize=7)

def get_image(idx, df_row):
    """Get image tensor for a sample by its DataFrame index."""
    if is_conv:
        # Conv model: features ARE the flattened image pixels
        feat = all_features[idx]
        C, H, W = image_shape
        return feat.view(C, H, W)
    elif images_dataset is not None:
        # Feature-based: look up in the image dataset using sample_id
        sid = int(df_row["sample_id"])
        img, label, _ = images_dataset[idx]
        return img
    return None

def show_image(ax, img_tensor, title="", fontsize=8):
    """Display an image tensor on a matplotlib axis."""
    if img_tensor is None:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "N/A", ha="center", va="center", transform=ax.transAxes)
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=fontsize)
        ax.axis("off")
        return
    img = img_tensor.squeeze().numpy()
    if img.ndim == 3 and img.shape[0] in (1, 3):
        img = np.transpose(img, (1, 2, 0))
    if img.ndim == 3 and img.shape[2] == 1:
        img = img.squeeze(-1)
    ax.imshow(img, cmap="gray" if img.ndim == 2 else None, vmin=0, vmax=1)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=fontsize)
    ax.axis("off")

def get_reconstruction(features_tensor, class_idx):
    """Get reconstruction from a specific class autoencoder (conv models only)."""
    if not is_conv:
        return None
    with torch.no_grad():
        feat = features_tensor.unsqueeze(0).to(DEVICE)
        recon, _ = model.ae_manager.forward_class(feat, class_idx)
        C, H, W = image_shape
        return recon.cpu().squeeze(0).view(C, H, W)

# Show examples for top confused pairs
n_pairs_to_show = min(N_TOP_PAIRS, 5)
for pair_idx in range(n_pairs_to_show):
    row = pair_counts.iloc[pair_idx]
    true_c, pred_c = int(row["true_label"]), int(row["predicted"])
    pair_name = row["pair"]

    # Get samples for this pair
    mask = (df_wrong["true_label"] == true_c) & (df_wrong["predicted"] == pred_c)
    pair_samples = df_wrong[mask].sort_values("rer", ascending=False)
    n_show = min(N_EXAMPLES, len(pair_samples))

    if n_show == 0:
        continue

    # Determine number of columns: original + (recon_true + recon_pred if conv)
    n_cols = n_show
    n_rows = 3 if is_conv else 1  # original, recon_true, recon_pred

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=(n_cols * 1.8, n_rows * 2))
    if n_rows == 1 and n_cols == 1:
        axes = np.array([[axes]])
    elif n_rows == 1:
        axes = axes[np.newaxis, :]
    elif n_cols == 1:
        axes = axes[:, np.newaxis]

    fig.suptitle(
        f"Pair: {pair_name}  (count={int(row['count'])}, mean RER={row['mean_rer']:.3f})",
        fontsize=10, fontweight="bold",
    )

    for i, (df_idx, sample) in enumerate(pair_samples.head(n_show).iterrows()):
        # Find position in the original arrays
        orig_idx = df.index.get_loc(df_idx)

        # Original image
        img = get_image(orig_idx, sample)
        title = (
            f"True: {sample['true_name']}\n"
            f"Pred: {sample['pred_name']}\n"
            f"2nd: {sample['second_name']}\n"
            f"RER: {sample['rer']:.3f}"
        )
        show_image(axes[0, i], img, title)

        if is_conv:
            # Reconstruction from true class AE
            recon_true = get_reconstruction(all_features[orig_idx], true_c)
            err_true = sample["own_class_error"]
            show_image(axes[1, i], recon_true, f"Recon (true={sample['true_name']})\nerr={err_true:.4f}")

            # Reconstruction from predicted class AE
            recon_pred = get_reconstruction(all_features[orig_idx], pred_c)
            err_pred = sample["pred_class_error"]
            show_image(axes[2, i], recon_pred, f"Recon (pred={sample['pred_name']})\nerr={err_pred:.4f}")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(16, 4.5))

# 1. RER histogram: correct vs misclassified
rer_correct = df.loc[df["correct"], "rer"].values
rer_wrong = df.loc[~df["correct"], "rer"].values
bins = np.linspace(0, min(df["rer"].quantile(0.99), 5.0), 60)
axes[0].hist(rer_correct, bins=bins, alpha=0.6, label=f"Correct (n={len(rer_correct)})", color="green", density=True)
axes[0].hist(rer_wrong, bins=bins, alpha=0.6, label=f"Wrong (n={len(rer_wrong)})", color="red", density=True)
axes[0].axvline(x=1.0, color="black", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, label="RER=1.0")
axes[0].set_xlabel("RER")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Density")
axes[0].set_title("RER Distribution: Correct vs Misclassified")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)

# 2. RER vs margin scatter
sample_idx = np.random.choice(len(df), min(5000, len(df)), replace=False)
df_sample = df.iloc[sample_idx]
colors = ["green" if c else "red" for c in df_sample["correct"]]
axes[1].scatter(df_sample["rer"], df_sample["margin"], c=colors, alpha=0.3, s=5)
axes[1].set_xlabel("RER")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Margin (error gap: 2nd - 1st)")
axes[1].set_title("RER vs Confidence Margin")
axes[1].set_xlim(0, min(df["rer"].quantile(0.99), 5.0))
# Custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
axes[1].legend(handles=[
    Patch(color="green", alpha=0.5, label="Correct"),
    Patch(color="red", alpha=0.5, label="Wrong"),
], fontsize=8)

# 3. Borderline samples: correctly classified but high RER
borderline = df[df["correct"] & (df["rer"] > 0.8)].sort_values("rer", ascending=False)
print(f"Borderline samples (correct but RER > 0.8): {len(borderline)}")
axes[2].hist(borderline["rer"].values, bins=30, color="orange", alpha=0.7)
axes[2].set_xlabel("RER")
axes[2].set_ylabel("Count")
axes[2].set_title(f"Borderline: Correct but High RER (n={len(borderline)})")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Show some borderline samples
if len(borderline) > 0:
    print("\nTop borderline samples (correct but uncertain):")
    display(borderline.head(10)[["true_name", "pred_name", "second_name", "rer", "margin", "own_class_error"]])

# Select class for deep dive
if DEEP_DIVE_CLASS is not None:
    dive_class = DEEP_DIVE_CLASS
else:
    dive_class = int(df_class.iloc[0]["class"])  # hardest class by chi

dive_name = class_names[dive_class]
dive_mask = df["true_label"] == dive_class
df_dive = df[dive_mask]
df_dive_wrong = df_dive[~df_dive["correct"]]

n_total = len(df_dive)
n_wrong = len(df_dive_wrong)
dive_acc = df_dive["correct"].mean()

print(f"Deep dive: class {dive_class} = '{dive_name}'")
print(f"  Samples: {n_total}, Errors: {n_wrong}, Accuracy: {dive_acc:.3f}")
print(f"  Mean RER: {df_dive['rer'].mean():.4f}, Median RER: {df_dive['rer'].median():.4f}")

# What does this class get confused with?
if n_wrong > 0:
    confused_with = df_dive_wrong.groupby("predicted").agg(
        count=("sample_id", "size"),
        mean_rer=("rer", "mean"),
    ).sort_values("count", ascending=False)
    confused_with["pred_name"] = [class_names[c] for c in confused_with.index]
    confused_with["pct"] = confused_with["count"] / n_wrong * 100

    print(f"\n  Confused with (top 10):")
    display(confused_with.head(10)[["pred_name", "count", "pct", "mean_rer"]])

    # What 2nd-best class do misclassified samples have?
    second_counts = df_dive_wrong["second_name"].value_counts().head(10)
    print(f"\n  2nd-best class for misclassified '{dive_name}' samples:")
    display(second_counts.to_frame("count"))

# Visualize: confusion breakdown for this class
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))

# RER distribution for this class
axes[0].hist(df_dive.loc[df_dive["correct"], "rer"].values, bins=30, alpha=0.6,
             color="green", label="Correct", density=True)
if n_wrong > 0:
    axes[0].hist(df_dive_wrong["rer"].values, bins=30, alpha=0.6,
                 color="red", label="Wrong", density=True)
axes[0].axvline(x=1.0, color="black", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
axes[0].set_xlabel("RER")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Density")
axes[0].set_title(f"RER Distribution for class '{dive_name}'")
axes[0].legend()

# Where errors go (pie/bar chart)
if n_wrong > 0:
    top_confused = confused_with.head(8)
    other_count = n_wrong - top_confused["count"].sum()
    labels = list(top_confused["pred_name"].values)
    sizes = list(top_confused["count"].values)
    if other_count > 0:
        labels.append("other")
        sizes.append(other_count)
    axes[1].barh(range(len(labels)), sizes, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(labels))))
    axes[1].set_yticks(range(len(labels)))
    axes[1].set_yticklabels(labels)
    axes[1].set_xlabel("Count")
    axes[1].set_title(f"Where '{dive_name}' errors go")
    axes[1].invert_yaxis()
else:
    axes[1].text(0.5, 0.5, "No errors!", ha="center", va="center", transform=axes[1].transAxes, fontsize=14)
    axes[1].set_title(f"'{dive_name}': perfect classification")

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Show example misclassified images for this class
if n_wrong > 0:
    n_show = min(10, n_wrong)
    dive_samples = df_dive_wrong.sort_values("rer", ascending=False).head(n_show)
    n_rows = 3 if is_conv else 1
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_show, figsize=(n_show * 1.8, n_rows * 2))
    if n_rows == 1 and n_show == 1:
        axes = np.array([[axes]])
    elif n_rows == 1:
        axes = axes[np.newaxis, :]
    elif n_show == 1:
        axes = axes[:, np.newaxis]

    fig.suptitle(f"Misclassified '{dive_name}' samples (sorted by RER, worst first)", fontsize=10)

    for i, (df_idx, sample) in enumerate(dive_samples.iterrows()):
        orig_idx = df.index.get_loc(df_idx)
        img = get_image(orig_idx, sample)
        title = f"Pred: {sample['pred_name']}\n2nd: {sample['second_name']}\nRER: {sample['rer']:.3f}"
        show_image(axes[0, i], img, title)

        if is_conv:
            recon_true = get_reconstruction(all_features[orig_idx], dive_class)
            show_image(axes[1, i], recon_true, f"Recon (true)\nerr={sample['own_class_error']:.4f}")
            recon_pred = get_reconstruction(all_features[orig_idx], int(sample["predicted"]))
            show_image(axes[2, i], recon_pred, f"Recon (pred)\nerr={sample['pred_class_error']:.4f}")

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
